title: PAGE_REASONS ties each waiting-page field to its guard rule, so the generated field table can carry a rule column
why: Lane skill-text-once 14:53 CST Nov 12: #2702 generates the field table without a guard-rule column, because code gives no field-to-rule tie (mockup-home and page-item-design are not in PAGE_REASONS); a hand-kept column would go stale unread.
note: Add a field-to-rule tie in PAGE_REASONS, including mockup-home and page-item-design; the generated table gains the rule column from it. Red first on a field with no tie. Round-3 note: skills/waiting-page/test_field_table.py reads page.html's itemFields block by its exact opener, so a format-only edit of that block turns it red. After #2702 merges.
